report.explanation: All observed checkout requests returned 200 with durations 78-344ms; traces show successful spans across inventory, payment, order, and postgres with no errors. Metrics show /v1/checkout p95 ~437ms but zero 502s and no dependency operation series. No evidence establishes a fault; healthy telemetry contradicts a fault hypothesis, so hand off for baseline and log review rather than assert a cause.
